checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Output is still 858x480 landscape; length ~10s is kept but vertical was not done.

must.item: Captions larger and bolder than first version with strong contrast
must.why: Second clip has big bold white Montserrat with black outline versus thin low-contrast text in the first.

must.item: Complete speech accurately subtitled and synchronized
must.why: Visible text matches the expected phrases, and 'Hi everyone!' is not visible in sampled frames. Sync cannot be judged from stills.

must.item: Captions fit within vertical frame and clear of TikTok UI areas
must.why: No vertical frame. The captions sit low over her body in the landscape frame, close to the right edge.

must.item: Face visible, undistorted, not covered by captions
must.why: The face is clear and the captions sit below it, over the chest and hands.

must.item: Original voice preserved, no dub or music
must.why: Audio is present, but I can't hear it. The agent says the audio is unchanged.

exact_text.read_as: not visible in sampled frames (frame at 1s has no caption)

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to / show you three easy
three easy / ways (split across two caption pages)

exact_text.text: to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: ways to make your / mornings less stressful.

faults.what: Video was not made vertical, which was an explicit request. It was left at 16:9 and the user was told to crop it elsewhere.
Captions overlap the chair and body area and run near the right edge, so a later 9:16 crop could cut them.
'Hi everyone!' is not captioned in the sampled frame at 1s.

summary: The captions are now big, bold and readable with word highlighting and the face is untouched, but the video is still landscape 16:9 and was not made vertical as requested.
